verdict.rationale: Decagon says technical teams keep "full visibility and control over guardrails" [decagon-docs-1/25], and its Duet-generated tests and Simulations check that agents "respond accurately" and "follow policies" before deployment [decagon-docs-11, decagon-docs-29]. Watchtower can also flag policy violations after the fact [decagon-docs-8], and knowledge-gap detection [decagon-docs-10] shows awareness of missing knowledge, though it drafts help-center content rather than enforcing a decline. Nothing explicitly says the agent refuses off-knowledge questions or is blocked from inventing prices or promises, so this is indirect support only. Missing for 10: a documented runtime grounding or refusal behaviour for off-knowledge questions, specific controls against made-up policies, prices or promises, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
